title: $[k]$-Roman domination on cylindrical grids $C_m \Box P_n$
summary: Roman domination and its higher-order extensions have attracted considerable attention due to their natural interpretation in terms of defensive resource allocation on networks. The recently introduced $[k]$-Roman domination framework unifies classical Roman, double, triple, and higher-strength protection schemes by allowing each fortified vertex to provide up to $k$ levels of support. In this paper, we investigate the $[k]$-Roman domination number $γ_{[k]R}(G)$ on cylindrical grids $C_m \Box P_n$.
